g.title: object_roles
g.text: Object roles: what the robot may touch

g.title: legend
g.text: the arm always keeps its full margin
default: full margin, halt on penetration
hand may come 3 cm closer, halt on penetration
hand and held object may touch it
in the gripper, moves with the hand
just let go, the hand may still touch it
within 3.5 cm of the hand at the keypose
between the fingers at the keypose
hand empty: first object hit in 3.5 cm of travel
holding: brought onto it, or resting on it
the gripper closes on it / opens
the hand has left the released object
keyframe over and hand 3.5 cm away,
or moving on its own > 3 cm/s
(not a pushed object while the hand touches it)
config / VLM restrict, only a human relaxes
> TARGET / NEAR > OBSTACLE. The table is never pushed.
